topSignals.title: Second consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 46 days quiet, Topsoe 71 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks, the full Tier 2 and Tier 3 rotations, every standing sweep query, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler, regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP, and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items (several candidates checked and confirmed pre-dated: a HyAxiom "$150M private placement" headline resolved to a 2023 financing; an "IDF/Oaktree $1.7B Nebius" and "Brookfield $25B" pairing resolved to the already-logged July 2026 announcements; a "Ceres Power China data centre deal" headline resolved to Nov 5, 2025). No SOFC order, PPA, pilot, regulatory action, earnings move, or benchmark datapoint was found today. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21, 2026 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 46 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27, 2026 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 71 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by PTX/ammonia/SAF/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation — round 4 (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy): no new stack/cell-technology items for either; results were recycled background (Bloom's 60%-electrical-efficiency hydrogen-SOFC announcement, the standing Oracle/AEP/Brookfield/Nebius deal cluster; FuelCell Energy's Torrington capex and pipeline-growth figures, all pre-dated).

Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; results recycled standing background, including a recirculating "Ceres Power shares soar on China data centre power deal" headline re-verified dated Nov 5, 2025 — one year old, not new.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — cycle 7, round 2 (Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Watt Fuel Cell), 7-day lookback: no new items for any of the six; results repeated standing IKTS/Plansee/Convion Hannover Fair background, CCTC's materials-supplier history, Ningbo SOFCMAN's general China-SOFC-market coverage, and Watt Fuel Cell's standing residential-CHP financing/shipment news (all pre-dated, none data-center- or benchmark-relevant).

Tier 3 sweep — "OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura OR Delta Electronics OR Denso OR Thermax": no new item; results repeated the standing Delta Electronics/Ceres SOFC-licensing agreement background, with no new 2026 disclosure from any of the seven.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway, Dec 7 air-permit hearing confirmed), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
